content: In the pretraining phase, we first pretrain MLM on monolingual corpora of both source and pivot languages, and continue to pretrain TLM or the proposed BRLM on the available parallel data between source and pivot languages, in order to build a cross-lingual encoder shared by the source and pivot languages.
